settings.title: Extension Settings
settings.subtitle: Manage capture overlay, local sync folder, browser cache, and library preferences
settings.floatingBtnLabel: Show floating capture button on supported sites
settings.floatingBtnDesc: Hide the floating button on pages. You can still capture via native favorites or shortcut (takes effect immediately).
settings.nativeCollectToastLabel: Show 5-second skip-save toast on native favorite
settings.nativeCollectToastDesc: When enabled, favoriting on a site shows a 5-second toast to skip local download (e.g. Support Creator / Watch Later). When off, saves silently right away.
settings.nsfwFilterDesc: Hide saved items from xvideos.com / pornhub.com or tagged "NSFW" (hidden only, not deleted)
settings.autoSyncAllDesc: When enabled, automatically syncs all account favorites on first visit. When off, prompts you before syncing.
settings.syncUncollectDesc: When you uncollect an item on the source site, automatically move it to Trash and cancel pending downloads.
settings.skipOversizedDesc: Skip auto-saving videos larger than the limit during favorite interception or full sync. Manual capture is unaffected.
settings.oversizedThresholdDesc: Default 200 MB. Pick a preset or enter a custom value ({min}–{max} MB).
settings.oversizedThresholdNotice: Video size limit set to {mb} MB
settings.oversizedNotifyPopupDesc: Popup: Show a 5-second card on page with video size and option to Save Anyway or Skip.
settings.oversizedNotifySilentDesc: Silent: Cancel auto-save quietly without showing any card.
settings.defaultFolderLabel: Fallback strategy when no folder is pre-selected
settings.defaultFolderDesc: Manually chosen folders always win; otherwise items follow this strategy (auto-classify falls back to Uncategorized on low confidence)
settings.concurrencyDesc: Limit simultaneous background downloads (1–5). Higher values may trigger rate limits.
settings.shortcutDesc: Press this shortcut on supported pages to capture immediately. Customize in browser extension shortcuts.
settings.shortcutOpenFailed: Cannot open shortcuts page automatically. Visit chrome://extensions/shortcuts manually ({error})
settings.gdriveClientIdPlaceholder: Enter Google Cloud Web OAuth Client ID
settings.gdriveRedirectUriLabel: Authorized Redirect URI (add in Google Cloud Console)
settings.gdriveScopeNotice: Uses non-sensitive drive.file scope only: CollectPlus can only access folders and files it creates, never other private files in your Drive. Access tokens stay in memory session only and are never written to disk or metadata.
settings.gdriveDisconnectedNotice: Disconnected Google Drive (cloud files remain intact)
settings.r2EndpointLabel: Account ID or S3 API Endpoint
settings.r2PrefixLabel: Root Prefix (optional, blank for bucket root)
settings.r2AccessKeyPlaceholder: Enter R2 API Token Access Key ID
settings.r2SecretKeyPlaceholder: Enter R2 API Token Secret Access Key
settings.r2SecurityNotice: Use a bucket-scoped Object Read & Write R2 API Token. Access Key ID and Secret Access Key stay in browser session memory only (cleared when browser closes) and are never written to IndexedDB, disk, or Vault metadata. Large videos use S3 multipart upload and presigned streaming playback.
settings.r2DisconnectedNotice: Disconnected Cloudflare R2 (bucket objects remain intact)
